headline: Evolutionary, sequence and structure models expand transcription factor motif inference
label: Transcription Factor Motif Discovery
summary: Three preprints dated 16–19 November 2026 propose new evidence sources for TF motif inference: evolutionary search, sequence models and predicted structures.
synthesis: The three preprints share a focus on transcription factor motif inference but differ in the source of motif evidence. The MAP-Elites approach uses evolutionary search with variable-length motif genotypes and diversity preservation to recover motifs under challenging confounder landscapes, validated against HOCOMOCO on five liver ChIP-seq datasets. The BPNet study, trained on about 2,000 ENCODE TF binding profiles, reports that motif cooperativity contributes negligibly to genome-wide binding. ZebraMotif instead models protein-DNA structures with AlphaFold3 and NA-MPNN to predict zebrafish TF motifs, covering 2,543 TFs. What is new is therefore the basis of motif evidence: evolutionary search, sequence-based modelling and predicted protein-DNA structure.
